migration.name: 0005_activity_metadata_scope.sql
migration.note: The pre-migration count query returned a transient Cloudflare 7403 error. Migration and post-migration reads succeeded. Journal preservation is covered by real SQLite migration tests; no remote before/after count equality is claimed.

before: Three tests reproduced resets from a later mint in Everyone and unrelated creator backfill in Profile/Following before the fix.
after: All three pass. Added tests preserve relevant publication backfill/deletion invalidation across scopes, detect mid-read metadata changes, and refresh legacy cursors.
compatibility: Metadata writes still advance the original global counter for older Workers. The new API subtracts the metadata clock and checks per-token revisions within scope and upper bounds.
limitations: Publication/time/reorg/follow invalidations remain conservative; this fix scopes metadata changes.
